title: AuditLogEntry
description: An audit log entry recording a system event, configuration change, or administrative action within the Workday tenant. Provides a complete record of the action, its context, and the outcome for compliance and security monitoring.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry

action.description: The specific action performed such as Create, Update, Delete, or View

description.description: Human-readable description of the audited event

previousValue.description: The previous value before the change for configuration modification events

newValue.description: The new value after the change for configuration modification events

ipAddress.description: IP address from which the action was performed

sessionId.description: Session identifier of the actor performing the action
